## Journey Details

### Configuration Journey — `Auto_Appraisal_Config_UJ`
- **Title:** Trade-in / Appraisal Management Org Configuration
- **Priority:** P0 · **Complexity (highest variant):** P2 (Multi-Brand OEM, Multi-Region)
- **Personas:** OEM Admin (primary), Dealer Admin (secondary)
- **Highlights:** PSL → User Permission 'Manage Appraisal' + Org Pref → Permission Sets (Dealer Sales Exec / Finance Manager / Service Advisor / External Community User) → Record Types (Vehicle + Asset on Appraisal & Appraisal Item) → Page Layouts per RT → Approval Process → OmniStudio (OmniScript + FlexCards) → picklists → RL whitelisting on Lead/Opportunity/Account/Asset → GV / Action Plan / DocumentChecklistItem / OmniAssessmentTask / Assessment whitelisting → Experience Cloud surfaces → ARC last (no change)
- **Sources:** Epic Doc — Licensing Impacts, TDs, Sections Information, Approval Workflow notes

### Setup Data Journey — `Auto_Appraisal_Data_UJ`
- **Title:** Trade-in / Appraisal Management Setup Data & Reference Entities
- **Priority:** P0 · **Complexity (highest variant):** P2
- **Personas:** SDET (primary), Implementation Consultant (secondary)
- **Highlights:** picklist value sets (Interest Type / Status / Adjustment Type / Condition / Exterior Colour / Mileage UoM / Owner / Usage UoM / Market Source) · Vehicle Definition graph · Vehicle (VIN-resolvable) · Asset + Asset Warranty · ProductRelatedComponent under AccessoryProduct · Lead + Lead Line Item · Opportunity + Opportunity Product · Person + Business Account · Approver user graph · Community user graph · Action Plan Templates · Document Checklist Items · Telemetry baseline counters · smoke / regression / perf data shapes
- **Sources:** Epic Doc — Appraisal Attributes (Vehicles + Assets), Appraisal Request Attributes, Appraisal Adjustment Attributes, Appraisal Accessories Attributes, Values Attributes, Telemetry section

### Integration Journey — `Auto_Appraisal_Integration_UJ`
- **Title:** Trade-in / Appraisal Management Integrations (Valuation Providers + Approval + GV / Document Framework)
- **Priority:** P0 · **Complexity (highest variant):** P2
- **Personas:** Integration Owner (primary), SDET (verification), Partner Engineer (Valuation adapter)
- **Highlights:**
  - **Valuation Provider** integration (Epic 8) — multi-provider fan-out, JSON contract, stub-vs-live, 5xx and malformed-JSON failure injection, Telemetry counters
  - **Approval Process** (Epic 9) — final-step Field Update Final Appraisal Price; reject → re-submit loop
  - **Generic Visit framework** (Epic 11, R256) — Inspection Visit via TD-0213024
  - **Action Plan / DocumentChecklistItem** (Epic 12, R256) — TD-0213023
  - **OmniAssessmentTask + Assessment** (TD-0213025 / TD-0213027)
  - **Inventory hand-off** (Epic 13, R256) — Field Service Inventory creation
  - **Opportunity / Lead Line Item / Quote** linkage (Epic 14, R256)
  - **Experience Cloud** (Epic 10) — sharing rules for external user
  - **Telemetry / Audit hooks** — counters, logged fields, no-PII guarantee
  - **BRE / Pricing Procedure** — explicitly NOT prescribed by Epic; flagged out-of-scope (P3) so the contract is honored without inventing capability
- **Sources:** Epic Doc — Process Flow, Epics 8/9/10/11/12/13/14, TDs section, Telemetry section
